title: trace reproducer-instrumentation.json
description: Optional sibling file at <bundle-dir>/reproducer-instrumentation.json. Data-config that opts a bundle's Builder runs into instrumented compilation modes. Out-of-band relative to the model: Reproducer and Patcher do NOT see this file, by design. Builder reads it, validates it, threads the mode through BuildRunner.run() for the unpatched/patched reproducer phases, and records the active mode under build.json.instrumentation. v0 supports asan only; UBSAN/MSAN/TSAN are explicitly out of scope.
